headline: Gold Slides Below $3,800 on Fed Hike Bets and Strong Dollar
teaser: Gold prices tumbled below the $3,800 level alongside steep drops in mining stocks amid growing expectations of Federal Reserve rate hikes. This sharp downturn highlights how surging borrowing costs and a strong dollar continue to pressure precious metals.
headline_km: តម្លៃមាសធ្លាក់ចុះក្រោម 3800 ដុល្លារ ដោយសារការរំពឹងទុកលើការដំឡើងអត្រាការប្រាក់ពី Fed និងប្រាក់ដុល្លារអាមេរិកខ្លាំង
